<!-- Floating Assistant Container -->
<div id="avatar-container" class="floating-avatar">
  <div id="avatar-sprite"></div>
</div>

<style>
.floating-avatar {
  position: fixed;
  top: 80px;   /* Anchors it near the top */
  left: 30px;  /* Anchors it to the left */
  
  /* Keep these at 240px so your frame math below works perfectly */
  width: 240px; 
  height: 240px; 
  
  /* THE MINIATURE TRICK: Shrinks the whole element down to 65% size */
  transform: scale(0.65);
  transform-origin: top left; /* Ensures it stays pinned to the corner when shrinking */
  
  border-radius: 50%; 
  overflow: hidden;
  z-index: 9999;
  pointer-events: none; 
}

#avatar-sprite {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background-image: url('assets/motion.webp');
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: 0px 0px; 
  mix-blend-mode: multiply; 
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const avatarContainer = document.getElementById("avatar-container");
  const sprite = document.getElementById("avatar-sprite");
  
  const CELL_WIDTH = 240;
  const CELL_HEIGHT = 240;
  const COLUMNS = 11;        
  const TOTAL_FRAMES = 121;   
  
  let ticking = false;

  window.addEventListener("scroll", () => {
    if (!ticking) {
      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        const scrollPx = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
        
        // ==========================================
        // 1. THE ANIMATION FIX
        // ==========================================
        // We calculate the maximum distance the user can POSSIBLY scroll on this specific page
        const maxPossibleScroll = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
        
        // We set the animation to finish at 600px, OR the bottom of the page (whichever comes first!)
        const SCROLL_THRESHOLD = Math.min(600, maxPossibleScroll); 
        
        // Calculate percentage, capping it at 1.0 (100%)
        let scrollPercent = Math.min(scrollPx / SCROLL_THRESHOLD, 1.0);
        let frameIndex = Math.floor(scrollPercent * (TOTAL_FRAMES - 1));
        
        const col = frameIndex % COLUMNS;
        const row = Math.floor(frameIndex / COLUMNS);
        const posX = -(col * CELL_WIDTH);
        const posY = -(row * CELL_HEIGHT);
        
        sprite.style.backgroundPosition = `${posX}px ${posY}px`;
        
        // ==========================================
        // 2. THE FADE-OUT EFFECT
        // ==========================================
        // Starts fading immediately, completely invisible by 400px of scrolling
        const FADE_THRESHOLD = 400; 
        let opacity = 1 - (scrollPx / FADE_THRESHOLD);
        avatarContainer.style.opacity = Math.max(opacity, 0);

        ticking = false;
      });
      ticking = true;
    }
  });
});
</script>

## Hello! 👋

I am a Data Scientist and **applied researcher** with a **Ph.D. in Spatial Statistics**. Over the past eight years, I have built predictive models to make sense of everything from large-scale networks to complex environmental systems. 

My true passion lies in taking highly complex spatial data and turning it into clear, rigorous insights. I enjoy blending foundational statistical methods, like **Bayesian inference** and **geostatistics**, with **modern AI tools** to build intelligent systems and novel methodologies that solve hard problems. 

Right now, my interests lie at the intersection of **AI Agentic Workflows** and **Complex Spatial Networks**. I am leveraging my background in computational statistics to explore how we can design AI systems capable of reasoning through and optimizing spatial data on their own.

* **Programming:** Python, R, SQL, SAS, Matlab.
* **AI & Machine Learning:** Prompt Engineering, GenAI Integrations, Agentic Workflows.
